title: Kissed Australian Noodle Dish
description: A light and kid-friendly Australian dish featuring brown rice noodles, mantecare-emulsify sauce, and vegetables, all wrapped in a banana leaf. This ovo-vegetarian friendly dish is perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the brown rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mantecare-emulsify sauce, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the mixed vegetables and cooked noodles to the bowl and toss to combine.
Stir in the sliced hard-boiled eggs.
Lay a banana leaf flat on a work surface and spoon the noodle mixture onto the center of the leaf.
Fold the banana leaf over the filling to form a packet and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Place the packets on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
Serve the Kissed Australian Noodle Dish hot and enjoy.
